meta.title: Script text in a weight name is stripped before it is stored
gaps: The available vocabulary has no operation for editing or reading a weight name or label.
This checks script sanitization on the event title, not on the weight name.
It does not verify HTTP 200 or the stored value "QA_Platform_alert(1)_…".

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event's title is what step 1 sent; the event's status is active.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the event's title is what step 1 sent; the event's status is active.

plan.title: Script text in a weight name is stripped before it is stored

assert.say: the event's title is what step 1 sent
